steps.title: Configure Build and Metadata
steps.description: Establish build configurations, compileSdk 34, and application package identifiers.

steps.title: Define Application Schemas
steps.description: Generate offline API schema, admin settings schema, and runtime asset metadata.

steps.title: Setup Manifest and Activity Configuration
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with application theme, orientation, and launch intent filters.

steps.title: Create Color Palette and Theme Values
steps.description: Define rich dark theme color palette, button states, accents, and typography resources in XML.

steps.title: Design Visual Drawables and Keypads
steps.description: Create shape drawables, button selectors with ripple states, badges, and expression card backgrounds.

steps.title: Build Main Calculator Layout
steps.description: Construct responsive layout featuring expression display, real-time result preview, scientific toggles, and keypad grid.

steps.title: Create History Item Layout
steps.description: Design layout for history list items with timestamp, previous expression, and result badges.

steps.title: Implement Math Expression Evaluator
steps.description: Develop recursive-descent math engine in native Java for robust evaluation of arithmetic, functions, and precedence.

steps.title: Implement Calculation History Model and Manager
steps.description: Create history item data model and persistent local storage manager for calculation records.

steps.title: Implement History Tape Adapter
steps.description: Develop list adapter displaying past computations with one-tap recall and removal capabilities.

steps.title: Assemble Main Activity Controller
steps.description: Connect keypad clicks, scientific expander, live evaluations, backspace gestures, and history drawer in MainActivity.

steps.title: Building ApexCalc
steps.description: Assemble and build final debug APK package for ApexCalc application.
